23588-a-filbert-is-a-nut.title: A Filbert Is A Nut
23588-a-filbert-is-a-nut.creator: Unknown
23588-a-filbert-is-a-nut.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. "We mustn't be antisocial, Mr. Funston," Miss Abercrombie said lightly, but firmly. "You've been coming along famously and you must remember to answer when someone talks to you. Now what are you making? It looks very complicated." She stared professionally at the maze of clay parts.

77128-ten-years-experience-in-raising-ca.title: Ten Years Experience In Raising Carrots And Cabbage
77128-ten-years-experience-in-raising-ca.creator: Unknown
77128-ten-years-experience-in-raising-ca.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. _Kind of Soil._—Should be the same as for corn. Loose ground, even, quite moist, will raise the largest carrots in a dry season, while a sandy or quite gravelly soil will do the best in a wet season. It is best to select a somewhat dry loam for the carrot patch.

arxiv-1804-04520.title: Complete homotopy invariants for translation invariant symmetric quantum walks on a chain
arxiv-1804-04520.creator: C. Cedzich, T. Geib, C. Stahl, L. Velázquez, A. H. Werner, R. F. Werner
arxiv-1804-04520.description: Abstract We provide a classification of translation invariant one-dimensional quantum walks with respect to continuous deformations preserving unitarity, locality, translation invariance, a gap condition, and some symmetry of the tenfold way. The classification largely matches the one recently obtained (arXiv:1611.04439) for a similar setting leaving out translation invariance.

arxiv-2101-09070.title: A sparse grid discrete ordinate discontinuous Galerkin method for the radiative transfer equation
arxiv-2101-09070.creator: Jianguo Huang, Yue Yu
arxiv-2101-09070.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Jianguo Huang, Yue Yu. The radiative transfer equation is a fundamental equation in transport theory and applications, which is a 5-dimensional PDE in the stationary one-velocity case, leading to great difficulties in numerical simulation. To tackle this bottleneck, we first use the discrete ordinate technique to discretize the scattering term, an integral with respect to the angular variables, resulting in a semi-discrete hyperbolic system. Then, we make the spatial discretization by means of the discontinuous Galerkin (DG) method combined with the sparse grid method.

arxiv-2211-03106.title: Bubble coalescence in interacting system of DNA molecules
arxiv-2211-03106.creator: U.A. Rozikov
arxiv-2211-03106.description: Abstract . We consider two models of interacting DNA molecules: First is (four parametric) bubble coalescence model in interacting DNAs (shortly: BCI-DNA). Second is (three parametric) bubble coalescence model in a condensed DNA molecules (shortly BCC-DNA). To study bubble coalescence thermodynamics of BCI-DNA and BCC-DNA models we use methods of statistical physics.

arxiv-2305-19882.title: Constructive mathematics and teaching
arxiv-2305-19882.creator: Alexander Shen
arxiv-2305-19882.description: Abstract Constructivists (and intuitionists in general) asked what kind of mental construction is needed to convince ourselves (and others) that some mathematical statement is true. This question has a much more practical (and even cynical) counterpart: a student of a mathematics class wants to know what will the teacher accept as a correct solution of a homework problem.

arxiv-2405-06896.title: Energy momentum tensor on and off the light cone: exposition with scalar Yukawa theory
arxiv-2405-06896.creator: Xianghui Cao, Siqi Xu, Yang Li, Guangyao Chen, Xingbo Zhao, Vladimir A. Karmanov, James P. Vary
arxiv-2405-06896.description: Abstract We compute the gravitational form factors A i A_{i} , D i D_{i} and c ¯ i \bar{c}_{i} of the scalar Yukawa theory using both the light-cone and covariant perturbation theory at the one-loop level. The light-cone formalism provides a potential approach to access these form factors beyond the perturbative regime.

arxiv-2408-05658.title: THE PRESSURE-ROBUST WEAK GALERKIN FINITE ELEMENT METHOD FOR STOKES-DARCY PROBLEM
arxiv-2408-05658.creator: Jiwei Jia, Lin Yang, Qilong Zhai
arxiv-2408-05658.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a pressure-robust weak Galerkin (WG) finite element scheme to solve the Stokes-Darcy problem. To construct the pressure-robust numerical scheme, we use the divergence-free velocity reconstruction operator to modify the test function on the right side of the numerical scheme.

arxiv-2412-14972.title: Frictional contact between solids: A fully Eulerian phase-field approach
arxiv-2412-14972.creator: Flavio Lorez, Mohit Pundir
arxiv-2412-14972.description: Abstract Recent advancements have demonstrated that fully Eulerian methods can effectively model frictionless contact between deformable solids. Unlike traditional Lagrangian approaches, which require contact detection and resolution algorithms, the Eulerian framework utilizes a single, fixed spatial mesh combined with a diffuse interface phase-field approach, simplifying contact resolution significantly.

arxiv-2507-22699.title: Image-Guided Shape-from-Template Using Mesh Inextensibility Constraints
arxiv-2507-22699.creator: Thuy Tran, Ruochen Chen, Shaifali Parashar
arxiv-2507-22699.description: Abstract Shape-from-Template (SfT) refers to the class of methods that reconstruct the 3D shape of a deforming object from images/videos using a 3D template. Traditional SfT methods require point correspondences between images and the texture of the 3D template in order to reconstruct 3D shapes from images/videos in real time.

arxiv-2603-02467.title: CCMnet : A Software Package for Network Generation with Congruence Class Models
arxiv-2603-02467.creator: Ravi Goyal, Victor De Gruttola, Natasha K. Martin, Lior Rennert, Jukka-Pekka Onnela

pmc-10647799.title: Preparation and Unique Three-Dimensional Self-Assembly Property of Starfish Ferritin
pmc-10647799.creator: Chenxi Zhang, Xuemin Chen, Bo Liu, Jiachen Zang, Tuo Zhang, Guanghua Zhao
pmc-10647799.description: The structure and assembly properties of ferritin derived from aquatic products remain to be explored. Constructing diverse three-dimensional (3D) protein architectures with the same building blocks has important implications for nutrient delivery, medicine and materials science. Herein, ferritin from Asterias forbesii (AfFer) was prepared, and its crystal structure was resolved at 1.91 Å for the first time.

pmc-11284878.title: Effect of pectineus muscle plane block versus femoral nerve block for postoperative analgesia and early recovery after knee surgery: a randomised controlled trial study protocol
pmc-11284878.creator: Qian Wang, Xin Men, Yan Xue, Xia-rong Qin
pmc-11284878.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundFemoral nerve block (FNB) is a prevalent method used for postoperative pain management after knee surgery; however, it decreases the strength of the quadriceps muscle and is not conducive to early recovery after surgery. Pectineus muscle plane (PMP) block involves the injection of a local anaesthetic into the fascial plane below the pectineus muscle, where it blocks the obturator and saphenous nerves. However, there is little evidence on the effectiveness of PMP block for analgesia after knee surgery.

pmc-11516793.title: An analysis into the rise of private healthcare in England by geographical location and time period
pmc-11516793.creator: L McCannn, I Holdroyd, R Emberson, H Painter, J Ford
pmc-11516793.description: BackgroundPrivate healthcare is a rapidly growing industry in the UK, particularly for surgical procedures. Across the pandemic period, waiting lists for elective surgical and consultant-led care increased from 4.4 to 7.5 million patients. This study aimed to analyse the trends and geographical variations in privately funded and NHS-funded orthopaedic private procedures across England compared to NHS waiting times.

pmc-12667382.title: Case Report: A Patient with Lambert-Eaton Myasthenic Syndrome Successfully Treated with Efgartigimod
pmc-12667382.creator: Lizhu Han, Jili Shen, Jie Wei, Yue Zhang
pmc-12667382.description: BackgroundLambert-Eaton myasthenic syndrome (LEMS) is a neuromuscular junction disorder which is frequently associated with tumors. Those patients generate pathogenic antibodies such as voltage-gated calcium channel (VGCC) antibodies. Existing studies have established the efficacy of efgartigimod in MG. This article reports the effect of efgartigimod following its administration to a patient with LEMS.

pmc-13227156.title: 3D imaging reveals robustness and plasticity of cell division in rice early embryogenesis
pmc-13227156.creator: Moeno Tezuka, Takunori Kitta, Haruka Kumakura, Moeko Sato, Naoya Kamamoto, Satoshi Naramoto, Hiroyuki Tsuji, Takashi Okamoto, Atsuko Kinoshita
pmc-13227156.description: Embryogenesis is an essential process involving a series of formative cell divisions that contribute to establishing the plant’s body axis. In many dicotyledons, the asymmetric cell division of the zygote gives rise to two daughter cells, which develop into two distinct cell lineages.

pmc-13238826.title: The Effect of Photobiomodulation in the Management of Leg Ulcers in Sickle Cell Disease: A Systematic Review
pmc-13238826.creator: Jéssica Eutímio de Carvalho Silva, Caroline Conceição da Guarda, Luciana Magalhães Fiuza, Teresa Cristina Cardoso Fonseca, Marilda de Souza Gonçalves, Milena Magalhães Aleluia
pmc-13238826.description: Leg ulcer (LU) is a chronic complication of sickle cell disease (SCD), characterised by intense pain, treatment resistance and a high impact on the patient's quality of life (QoL), representing a significant public health challenge. Clinical management involves multifaceted approaches; however, the variability in response to conventional treatments highlights the need for more effective and evidence‐based alternatives.

pmc-13253115.title: Clinical evidence on integrated Chinese-Western medicine for primary dysmenorrhea
pmc-13253115.creator: Xuan Yu, Zijing Wang, Yanfang Ma, Shouyuan Wu, Hui Liu, Ke Xu, Jie Zhang, Huayu Zhang, Yaolong Chen, Zhaoxiang Bian
pmc-13253115.description: BackgroundPrimary dysmenorrhea (PD), a common gynecological disorder, adversely affects the quality of life, mental health, and overall well-being of many young women. Given concerns about adverse effects of some Western medications, Chinese medicine (CM) and integrated Chinese–Western medicine (ICWM) approaches have gained attention.

pmc-13369805.title: A hyperspectral imaging framework integrating band selection and deep learning for beverage stain classification in forensic analysis
pmc-13369805.creator: Jitendra Shit, Partha Pratim Roy, V M Manikandan
pmc-13369805.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The technique of Hyperspectral Imaging (HSI) is significant in the field of non-destructive forensic crime scene investigation, as it allows for the identification of minor spectral changes over a broad range of wavelengths. In the present study, the spectral characteristics of nine beverage stains, such as Papaya, Coffee, Pomegranate, Orange, Tea, Wine, Whisky, Rum, and Brandy, were studied by simulating a controlled environment for a mock crime scene.

pmc-13371743.creator: Artemisa R Dores, Julius Burkaukas, Agne Stanyte, Aiste Pranckeviciene, Irene P Carvalho, Thomas Zandonai, Pierluigi Simonato, Ilaria De Luca, Alessandro Carollo, Krisztina Edina Ábel, Attila Szabo, Rita Kovácsik, Hironobu Fujiwara, Mami Shibata, Andreea Girleanu, Alejandra Rebeca Melero Ventola, Ricardo M Santos-Labrador, Nelson Bruno de Almeida Cunha, Gabriele Penazzi, Sofia Venturini, Fabio Castro, Lambros Lazuras, Gianluca Esposito, Zsolt Demetrovics, Ornella Corazza

pmc-13433425.title: Transition dynamics modeling of pre-trained accelerometry representations for time to diagnosis of Parkinson’s disease
pmc-13433425.creator: Huiming Xie, Fei Xue, Xiao Wang
pmc-13433425.description: Early identification of Parkinson’s disease is critical for timely intervention. Disruptions in sleep architecture and changes in physical activity patterns have been reported years before motor symptom onset, yet prodromal behavioral changes spanning sleep and daytime activity patterns are subtle and difficult to detect with conventional clinical tools.

pmc-13434051.title: Structure and receptor recognition of type-II feline infectious peritonitis virus spike glycoprotein
pmc-13434051.creator: Sheng Niu, Yuyang Tian, Linh Nguyen, Chongzhi Bai, Xiaohan Hou, Dan Wang, Ziqian Niu, Zhimin Liu, Jianle Ren, Wentao Li, Qihui Wang, Wen-xia Tian, Junqing Sun, George Fu Gao
pmc-13434051.description: Type-II feline infectious peritonitis virus (FIPV-II) is a lethal alphacoronavirus, whose high homology with the human coronavirus CCoV-HuPn-2018 carries the risk of potential zoonotic FIPV-II transmission to humans. FIPV-II infects felids using cat aminopeptidase N (cAPN) as its cell-entry receptor, but the molecular details remain unclear.

pmc-13492011.title: Assessment of the Position of Maxillary Sinus Floor in Relation to Alveolar Ridge, Location of Sinus Septa, and Posterior Superior Alveolar Artery in the Chhattisgarh Population: A Cone-Beam Computed Tomography Analysis
pmc-13492011.creator: Avinash Kumar, Saumya Sharma, Sanjeev Singh, Priyabrata Jena, Baby Jaman, Aviraj Gill, Pankaj Bajaj
pmc-13492011.description: Background: Substantial anatomical diversity exists within the maxillary sinus, particularly in relation to the alveolar crest, sinus septa, and the posterior superior alveolar artery (PSAA). Such variations hold important clinical implications, especially in procedures involving implant placement and sinus floor elevation.

pmc-13562217.title: The role of attention in perceptual biases in patients with schizophrenia spectrum disorder and healthy controls
pmc-13562217.creator: Alexander C Schütz, Ogün Bolat, Kin Kori, Tilo Kircher, Benjamin Straube
pmc-13562217.description: Ambiguous or uncertain sensory information is often resolved by incorporating prior assumptions about the most likely interpretation. Similar neural structures and a common visual environment typically lead to homogeneous priors in the population. Ambiguous motion displays are a rare exception as sustained idiosyncratic directional preferences have been observed.
